page=canvas(size=(180 mm,150 mm),background="#ffffff")
s=plot_style(font_family="/workspace/LayMesh/examples/assets/DejaVuSans.ttf")
p=plot(projection="polar",size=(110 mm,100 mm),plot_area=box(offset=(20 mm, 15 mm), size=(70 mm, 60 mm)),style=s,theta=axis(range=(0,360)),r=axis(range=(0,10)))
p.scatter(theta=[0,90,180,270],r=[10,10,10,10],marker_size=2 mm)
a=page.add(p)
page.add(rect(size=(1 mm, 1 mm)),anchor=center,target=a.data(theta=90,r=10))
page.add(rect(size=(1 mm, 1 mm)),anchor=center,target=a.data(theta=270,r=-10))
page.add(p,size=(140 mm, 120 mm))
